tasks.title: Make issue review APIs availability-aware
tasks.description: Update the issue diff, commits, and commit-diff endpoints so they return explicit review availability, base/head metadata, summary counts, and user-facing unavailable reasons instead of ambiguous empty arrays. Fix the commits parser to return the complete base-to-head commit range with per-commit stats and touched files while the issue worktree exists.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues/:number/diff returns available=true with base, head, summary, and complete file entries when the worktree and branches exist
GET /api/issues/:number/commits returns the complete base..head commit range with hash, message, author, date, filesChanged, additions, deletions, and files
GET /api/issues/:number/commits/:hash/diff returns an availability-aware payload and patch diff for commits that belong to the issue branch
Missing worktree, missing branch, not-started, and git error states return explicit reason/message values and are not represented as indistinguishable empty arrays
Multi-commit issue branches are not collapsed to one commit by git log/stat parsing
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes existing WorktreeManager/project/issue data and produces the backend response contract used by later UI work. Prefer --numstat for parseable stats and preserve lazy commit patch loading.

tasks.title: Show Issue Detail review summary
tasks.description: Update frontend review response types, API client methods, and hooks to consume the availability-aware API contract. Use that data in IssueDetailPage to render a top review summary with base/head, files changed, commit count, additions, deletions, worktree availability, and existing merge truth when review data is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend types model availability-aware diff, commits, and commit-diff responses as explicit response types
api.ts and useQueries.ts return the new review response shapes without requiring components to infer availability from array length
Issue Detail top context shows base/head, files count, commit count, additions, deletions, worktree retained/removed state, and merge state when available
Unavailable review data does not crash the Issue Detail header
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the response shapes produced by T-001. Expected files include packages/cli/web/src/lib/types.ts, packages/cli/web/src/lib/api.ts, packages/cli/web/src/hooks/useQueries.ts, and IssueDetailPage.tsx.

tasks.title: Render files-first PR-like Changes panel
tasks.description: Update the Changes panel to consume availability-aware review data and render the PR-like review surface. The panel should default to Files changed, show complete file diffs, provide a Commits companion view with complete commit history, lazily expand commit patches, and distinguish no-changes states from unavailable lifecycle states.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue Detail initializes the Changes tab to Files changed by default
Changes panel displays base/head, files changed, commit count, additions, deletions, and worktree availability when review data is available
Files changed tab shows the complete file list and expandable per-file diffs rendered by DiffViewer
Commits tab shows every commit with hash, message, author/time, files touched, additions, and deletions
Expanding a commit lazily loads and renders the commit patch with DiffViewer
Backlog or not-started issues show No changes yet, while removed worktrees show a Changes unavailable workspace-removed message instead of No changes yet or No commits yet
Branch missing and git/API failure states display specific explanatory messages
No new external diff rendering dependency is introduced
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the backend contract from T-001 and frontend response types/hooks from T-002. Expected files include ChangesPanel.tsx, IssueDetailPage.tsx, and any small supporting UI helpers needed for state copy.

tasks.title: Add review surface regression coverage
tasks.description: Add or update automated tests for the backend review API contract and the frontend lifecycle-specific Changes states. Cover the multi-commit parser regression, availability reasons, files-first default behavior, and workspace-removed UI copy so future changes cannot silently restore the ambiguous review surface.
acceptanceCriteria: A backend test proves a multi-commit git log/numstat sample returns all commits with nonzero stats where expected
Backend tests cover worktree_removed, not_started, branch_missing, and git_error availability payload behavior where practical
Frontend tests or component-level assertions cover Files changed as the default tab and workspace removed copy replacing No changes yet
Existing test suite passes
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the backend contract from T-001 and frontend UI behavior from T-002/T-003. If there is no established component test harness for this panel, prefer focused backend tests plus the closest existing frontend test pattern.
